verdict.rationale: Folk's integrations page documents several first-party, prebuilt integrations: Google contacts sync, conversation and contact import, one-click LinkedIn imports and Gmail sync. That is a real but narrow form of the capability, and none of the story's named categories are shown. Missing for 10: evidence of a browsable app marketplace with self-serve install, Slack integration, support-desk integration, marketing-tool integration, data-warehouse integration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: Automatically import and sync your Google contacts with folk
